description: DroneBundle lets users ask ChatGPT about authorized drone operations data, including projects, jobs, flights, pilots, equipment, maintenance, safety, clients, invoices, documents, discussions, and job-site weather. It provides read-only access and cannot create, update, or delete workspace records.

defaultPrompt: Show me an overview of my drone operations.
Which flights are scheduled this week?
Summarize equipment maintenance that needs attention.
